# Yuno API Documentation

> Yuno is the AI operating system for payments: one integration to accept payment methods, processors and fraud tools worldwide. Guides, SDKs for iOS, Android, Web and React Native, the REST API reference and the changelog.

## Agent Instructions

Test in the sandbox first: base URL https://api-sandbox.y.uno (Test Mode in the Dashboard). Production is https://api.y.uno (Live Mode).
Every API request needs the public-api-key and private-secret-key headers. Get them in the Dashboard at https://dashboard.y.uno/developers (Developers > Credentials); sandbox and production keys are different.
Send an X-Idempotency-Key (a UUID) when creating payments, refunds and cancels, so retries do not create duplicates.
Start with the Quickstart (https://docs.y.uno/docs/quickstart.md) and the agent guide (https://docs.y.uno/agents.md). To search these docs from a coding agent, connect the docs MCP server at https://docs.y.uno/mcp.

## Indexes

> The links below point to documentation indexes. Follow each `/_llms/` index to reach the pages.

- [Documentation (144 pages)](https://docs.y.uno/_llms/documentation.txt): Getting Started, Core Concepts, Using Yuno, Direct Integration Use Cases, Payment Features, Payouts and Disputes, Webhooks, Wallets, AI Capabilities, Security and Compliance, Plugins, Additional Services.
- [API Reference (270 pages)](https://docs.y.uno/_llms/api-reference.txt): Getting Started, Reference, Customers, Network Tokens, Customer Sessions (Enrollment), Checkout Sessions, Payment Methods (Checkout), Checkout Builder, Payment Methods (Direct Workflow), PCI Proxy, Payments, Pre-Debit Notifications, 3DS2 Setup, Unreferenced Refunds, Dry-run, Transaction Reporting, Routing Recommendations, Payment Links, Recipients for Marketplace, Sellers (Franchise), Subscriptions Plans, Subscriptions, Payouts, Organizations, Reports, Installments, AI Caller, Communications Campaigns, Conversion Rate, FX Rates, Banking Connectivity, Webhooks.

## SDK

### Start here

- [Get Started](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/get-started.md): Accept your first payment in sandbox, where no real money moves.
- [Build with AI](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/build-with-ai.md): Install and integrate the Yuno SDK with your AI coding agent.

#### Overview

- [Overview](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/introduction.md): Yuno SDKs for iOS, Android, React Native, and Web.
- [How a transaction flows](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/how-a-transaction-flows.md): Who does what, in which order, when a payment or an enrollment runs through the Yuno SDK.
- [Checkout preview](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/checkout-preview.md): Pick a country, payment methods and styles, and see how your customers will pay with Yuno.
- [A faster checkout](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/features/form-behavior.md): What the SDK's built-in form does for your shoppers, out of the box.

### Guides

- [Where do I start?](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/where-do-i-start.md): Decide which parameters and controllers to use based on what you want to build.
- [Payment Methods List](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/features/payment-methods-list.md): Render pre-built views for payment methods, including express buttons.
- [Secure Fields](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/features/secure-fields.md): Collect card data in PCI-compliant fields you place and style individually, then pay or enroll with start().
- [Split one payment across two cards](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/features/split-payment.md): Build the object that splits one payment across two cards, start it, create the payment and read the result on Web, iOS, Android and React Native.
- [Enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/features/enrollment.md): Save a customer's payment method for future use, without charging.
- [Handle deeplinks](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/features/handle-deeplinks.md): Forward incoming URLs to the SDK so it can resume a transaction after returning from an external app or page.
- [Native modules](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/features/native-modules.md): Add a third-party native SDK, antifraud, 3DS or Revolut Pay, to the Yuno SDK as an optional module, without changing your transaction code.
- [Styling](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/features/styling.md): Customize the visual appearance of the SDK's built-in views.

### Listen and take over

- [Overview](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/controllers/overview.md): Override controllers to control how the SDK renders, submits, and finishes transactions.
- [onStatus](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/controllers/on-status.md): Receives the final status of the transaction.

#### Take over the SDK

- [Take over the SDK](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/controllers/take-over-the-sdk.md): The controllers that replace something the SDK does by default: presenting views, showing the loader, and creating the payment.
- [showView](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/controllers/show-view.md): Invoked when the SDK has a view to present (form or action).
- [showLoading](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/controllers/show-loading.md): Invoked when the SDK enters or exits a loading state.
- [createPayment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/controllers/create-payment.md): Override to create the payment on your own backend.

#### Listen to events

- [Listen to events](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/controllers/listen-to-events.md): The controllers that only report what happens during a transaction: the installment the shopper picked, the card they are typing and the shipping address they selected.
- [onInstallmentSelected](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/controllers/on-installment-selected.md): Invoked when the buyer picks an installment option in the card form.
- [onCardInfoChanged](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/controllers/on-card-info-changed.md): Invoked with the card brand, type, category, issuer and country while the shopper types the card number.
- [onShippingAddressChanged](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/controllers/on-shipping-address-changed.md): Invoked when the shopper selects or changes the shipping address in a wallet payment sheet.

### API reference

- [Objects you pass](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/reference/objects-you-pass.md): The objects your app builds and hands to the SDK: TransactionConfig, PaymentMethodSelected and TransactionData.
- [Objects you receive](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/reference/objects-you-receive.md): The objects the SDK hands back to your app: Status and OneTimeToken.

### Upgrade from older SDKs

- [Migration Overview](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/overview.md): Move from any legacy Yuno SDK mode to the unified Transaction API.

#### iOS

##### Payment

- [Lite mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/ios/payment/lite.md): Migrate iOS Lite integrations (Yuno.startPaymentLite) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Full mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/ios/payment/full.md): Migrate iOS Full integrations (Yuno.getPaymentMethodViewAsync + Yuno.startPayment) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Render mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/ios/payment/render.md): Migrate iOS Render integrations (Yuno.startPaymentRenderFlow + formView + submitForm) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Headless mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/ios/payment/headless.md): Migrate iOS Headless integrations (Yuno.apiClientPayment + generateToken) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Seamless mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/ios/payment/seamless.md): Migrate iOS Seamless integrations (Yuno.startPaymentSeamlessLite) to the unified Transaction API.

##### Enrollment

- [Lite enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/ios/enrollment/lite.md): Migrate iOS Lite enrollment (Yuno.enrollPayment) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Render enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/ios/enrollment/render.md): Migrate iOS Render enrollment (Yuno.startEnrollmentRender) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Headless enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/ios/enrollment/headless.md): Migrate iOS Headless enrollment (Yuno.apiClientEnroll) to the unified Transaction API.

#### Android

##### Payment

- [Lite mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/android/payment/lite.md): Migrate Android Lite integrations (Activity.startCheckout + Activity.startPaymentLite) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Full mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/android/payment/full.md): Migrate Android Full integrations (Activity.startCheckout + Activity.startPayment) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Render mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/android/payment/render.md): Migrate Android Render integrations (Activity.startPaymentRender + YunoPaymentRenderListener) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Headless mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/android/payment/headless.md): Migrate Android Headless integrations (Yuno.apiClientPayment + generateToken) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Seamless mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/android/payment/seamless.md): Migrate Android Seamless integrations (Activity.startPaymentSeamlessLite) to the unified Transaction API.

##### Enrollment

- [Lite enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/android/enrollment/lite.md): Migrate Android Lite enrollment (Activity.startEnrollment) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Render enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/android/enrollment/render.md): Migrate Android Render enrollment (Activity.startEnrollmentRender) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Headless enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/android/enrollment/headless.md): Migrate Android Headless enrollment (Yuno.apiClientEnroll) to the unified Transaction API.

#### Web

- [Lite mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/web/lite.md): Migrate Web Lite integrations (yuno.startCheckout + yuno.mountCheckoutLite) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Full mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/web/full.md): Migrate Web Full integrations (yuno.startCheckout with the embedded payment-method list) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Headless mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/web/headless.md): Migrate Web Headless integrations (yuno.apiClientPayment) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Seamless mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/web/seamless.md): Migrate Web Seamless integrations (yuno.startSeamlessCheckout + yuno.mountSeamlessCheckout / mountSeamlessExternalButtons) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Seamless Lite mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/web/seamless-lite.md): Migrate Web Seamless Lite integrations (yuno.startSeamlessCheckout + yuno.mountSeamlessCheckoutLite) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Secure Fields](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/web/secure-fields.md): Migrate Web Secure Fields (yuno.secureFields) integrations to the unified Transaction API.
- [Enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/web/enrollment.md): Migrate Web enrollment integrations (yuno.mountEnrollmentLite + yuno.apiClientEnroll) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Fraud](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/web/fraud.md): Migrate Web fraud integrations (yuno.mountFraud + yuno.executeFraudCheck) to the unified SDK.
- [Payment status](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/web/status.md): Migrate the Web standalone status screen (yuno.mountStatusPayment) to the unified SDK.

#### React Native

##### Payment

- [Lite mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/react-native/payment/lite.md): Migrate React Native Lite integrations (YunoSdk.startPaymentLite) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Full mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/react-native/payment/full.md): Migrate React Native Full integrations (YunoPaymentMethods + YunoSdk.startPayment) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Headless mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/react-native/payment/headless.md): Migrate React Native Headless integrations (YunoSdk.generateToken + continueCardPayment) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Seamless Lite mode](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/react-native/payment/seamless-lite.md): Migrate React Native Seamless Lite integrations (YunoSdk.startPaymentSeamlessLite) to the unified Transaction API.

##### Enrollment

- [Lite enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/react-native/enrollment/lite.md): Migrate React Native enrollment (YunoSdk.enrollmentPayment) to the unified Transaction API.
- [Headless enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/react-native/enrollment/headless.md): Migrate React Native headless enrollment (YunoSdk.continueEnrollment) to the unified Transaction API.

### Card Enrollment

- [Web Enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/card-enrollment/web-enrollment.md): Enroll payment methods on Web using full-checkout, mounting the enrollment form and handling callbacks
- [Android Enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/card-enrollment/android-enrollment.md): Enroll payment methods on Android using full-checkout with pre-built UI and ProGuard configuration
- [iOS Enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/card-enrollment/ios-enrollment.md): Enroll payment methods on iOS using full-checkout with the enrollment delegate and result handling
- [Visa Tap to Add (Android)](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/card-enrollment/visa-tap-to-add-android.md): Enroll contactless Visa cards via NFC on Android with the Yuno Tap SDK or full checkout.

- [White Label Proxy Server](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/customization/web/white-label-proxy-server.md): A local Express harness that loads the Yuno Web SDK from a non-Yuno origin to verify white-label paths.

### Validate your integration

- [Validate your integration](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/validators/index.md): Markdown checklists that an AI coding agent runs against your repository to find Yuno Web SDK integration mistakes, with file and line for each finding.
- [Validator: Web SDK v1 checkout flows](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/validators/web-sdk-v1-checkout-flows.md): A read-only checklist for AI coding agents that audits Full, Lite, Seamless, external buttons, enrollment and status flows of a Yuno Web SDK 1.11 integration.
- [Validator: Web SDK v1 headless and Secure Fields](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/validators/web-sdk-v1-headless-secure-fields.md): A read-only checklist for AI coding agents that audits headless payment and enrollment, the two-card split and Secure Fields in a Yuno Web SDK 1.11 integration.
- [Validator: Web SDK v2](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/validators/web-sdk-v2.md): A read-only checklist for AI coding agents that audits a Yuno Web SDK 2.x integration built on SdkPayments.initialize and sdk.transaction.
- [Validator: Web SDK v1 to v2 migration](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/validators/web-sdk-v1-to-v2-migration.md): A read-only checklist for AI coding agents that lists what a Yuno Web SDK 1.11 integration must change to move to v2, and which flows have no v2 equivalent yet.

### External Native Modules

- [External Native Modules (iOS)](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/external-native-modules/ios-overview.md): Add a third-party native SDK (antifraud, 3DS, Revolut Pay) to the Yuno iOS SDK without changing your payment code.
- [External Native Modules (Android)](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/external-native-modules/android-overview.md): Add a third-party native SDK (antifraud, 3DS, Revolut Pay) to the Yuno Android SDK without changing your payment code.
- [3DS Native SDKs (iOS)](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/external-native-modules/netcetera-3ds-ios.md): Run 3D Secure challenges natively in your iOS app with Netcetera's 3DS SDK.
- [3DS Native SDKs (Android)](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/external-native-modules/netcetera-3ds-android.md): Run 3D Secure challenges natively in your Android app with Netcetera's 3DS SDK.
- [Signifyd Antifraud (iOS)](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/external-native-modules/signifyd-ios.md): Add Signifyd device profiling to Yuno iOS checkouts with the YunoAntifraudSignifyd module.
- [Signifyd Antifraud (Android)](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/external-native-modules/signifyd-android.md): Add Signifyd device profiling to Yuno Android checkouts with the yuno-sdk-antifraud-signifyd module.

### Migration guide

#### Web

- [Web SDK: Migrating to v1.5](https://docs.y.uno/changelog/migration-guides/web/v1-4-to-v1-5.md): Upgrade the Yuno Web SDK from v1.4 to v1.5.0, including the Lite SDK mountExternalButtons change
- [Web SDK: Migrating to v1.2](https://docs.y.uno/changelog/migration-guides/web/v1-1-to-v1-2.md): Upgrade the Yuno Web SDK from v1.1 to v1.2.0 in your checkout
- [Web SDK: Migrating to v1.1](https://docs.y.uno/changelog/migration-guides/web/v1-0-to-v1-1.md): Upgrade the Yuno Web SDK from v1.0 to v1.1.0 in your checkout

#### iOS

- [iOS SDK: Migrating to v2.12](https://docs.y.uno/changelog/migration-guides/ios/v2-11-to-v2-12.md): Upgrade the Yuno iOS SDK from v2.11.x to v2.12.0 in your app
- [iOS SDK: From v1.1 to v1.2 (Legacy)](https://docs.y.uno/changelog/migration-guides/ios/v1-1-to-v1-2.md): Historical migration guide for iOS SDK v1.1 to v1.2

#### Android

- [Android SDK: Migrating to v2.11](https://docs.y.uno/changelog/migration-guides/android/v2-10-to-v2-11.md): How to upgrade from Android SDK v2.10.x to v2.11.0
- [Android SDK: From v1.1 to v1.2 (Legacy)](https://docs.y.uno/changelog/migration-guides/android/v1-1-to-v1-2.md): Historical migration guide for Android SDK v1.1 to v1.2
